tests.goal: App holds up on a smaller screen

steps.action: Resize the browser to a mobile or tablet width.
Navigate the chat, sidebar and settings.
acceptanceCriteria: All screens remain usable without clipped or overlapping content

steps.action: Load the app and check the logo, favicon and colour theme.
acceptanceCriteria: The Deloitte GEL logo, favicon and colour theme are displayed correctly

steps.action: Open the login page in a new browser session or private window.
acceptanceCriteria: The updated login-screen logo is displayed clearly
The SSO sign-in button uses the approved updated branding and text
The browser tab displays the Deloitte favicon
The login screen uses the updated background image

steps.action: Check at a standard desktop size and a narrow mobile viewport.
acceptanceCriteria: No old, missing, stretched, blurred, clipped or misplaced branding

steps.action: Open the login page and check all visible MyAssist branding.
Sign in and inspect the landing page, header, sidebar, menus, Settings, About content if available, dialogs, notifications and empty states.
Open representative chats, agents, skills, projects and marketplace pages.
Check the browser tab title and any visible footer or version text.
acceptanceCriteria: "MyAssist 2.0" and any branded use of "2.0" do not appear anywhere
Any remaining occurrence is recorded with its exact page and text

tests.goal: Restyles Terms modal with GEL components

steps.action: Open the Terms modal (avatar menu > Help > Terms).
acceptanceCriteria: The layout, styling, scrolling and buttons look correct in both light and dark mode

tests.goal: Loads private Azure avatars in all views

steps.action: Sign in as a user who has a profile picture.
acceptanceCriteria: The picture is shown at the bottom left

steps.action: Sign in and use the app, then leave your browser open until after the next stand-up.

acceptanceCriteria: You are not signed out within a single day
